source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Ring Topology' (PDF 11): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Ring topology mein devices ek circular path (gol daire) mein jure hote hain (jaise Figure 1.10 mein). Data ring mein ek hi direction (simt) mein chalta hai. Har device data leta hai aur aage pass kar deta hai. Ek device fail ho to poore network par asar par sakta hai. Yeh bus topology se zyada complex (pecheeda) hai. Aaj kal ring topology bohat kam istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Ring topology: aik gol cable par rakhe devices: do tower computers, do desktop computers, laptop, printer aur oopar Wi-Fi nishan wala globe.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.10: Ring topology (kitab ki Figure 1.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba ek daire mein khare hon aur ek paighaam aage barhayein. Baat karein ke agar ek talib-e-ilm ruk jaye to kya hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity mein ek student paighaam aage dena band kar de to kya hota hai, aur yeh ring topology ke baare mein kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Paighaam aage nahi jata. Isi tarah ring mein ek device kharab ho to data aage nahi barhta aur poore network par asar (asar zada) ho sakta hai.

items: Ring: devices gol daire mein, data ek simt mein; ek device kharab to poore network par asar; aaj kal kam istemal.
